requirements.title: Tmux popup keybinding launches omp from OpenCode session
requirements.body: open-chad must provide a tmux keybinding that opens omp in a popup from within an active OpenCode session using display-popup -EE so successful runs close automatically and failures remain visible.

scenarios.title: Open popup from active OpenCode session
given: an active open-chad tmux session is running OpenCode
then: a tmux popup opens and runs omp
the popup default size is 80%x80% unless overridden

scenarios.title: Successful omp run closes popup
given: omp is launched inside the popup
then: focus returns to the previous OpenCode pane

scenarios.title: Failed omp run remains visible
given: omp exits with a non-zero status
then: failure output is visible for diagnosis

requirements.title: Popup flow preserves graceful user-close semantics
requirements.body: omp must treat user-initiated close actions (q, esc, ctrl+c) as graceful exits with status code 0 so popup usage does not produce error flashes.

scenarios.title: User quits with q or esc
given: omp is running in a tmux popup
scenarios.when: the user presses q or esc
then: the popup closes and returns focus to OpenCode

scenarios.title: User interrupts with ctrl+c
given: omp is running in a tmux popup
then: no error banner or failure flash is shown

scenarios.title: Preference changes apply on next invocation
given: a user updates an agent or command model in omp
scenarios.when: the user invokes that agent or command in OpenCode
then: the updated model preference is read from ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json
the new model is used on the next invocation
